title: Hardcoded API token in client config
description: A live-format API token is committed to the repository.
impact: Credential disclosure allows third-party API access.
technical_analysis: src/config.ts initializes the SDK with a literal token.
evidence: src/config.ts line 12 contains a token matching the vendor format.
poc_description: The token authenticates against the vendor API.
remediation_steps: Rotate the token and load it from the environment.
